definition.en: Turbulence at high level away from visible cloud, usually linked to strong vertical wind shear near the jet stream; it cannot be seen and is not shown by weather radar.
definition.es: Turbulencia en niveles altos lejos de nubes visibles, normalmente asociada a una fuerte cizalladura vertical del viento cerca de la corriente en chorro; no se ve y el radar meteorológico no la detecta.

simple.en: Bumps in a clear blue sky, usually near the jet stream.
simple.es: Baches con el cielo despejado, normalmente cerca de la corriente en chorro.

example.en: Moderate CAT was reported at FL370 over the Atlantic.
example.es: Se notificó CAT moderada a FL370 sobre el Atlántico.
